result.summary: The page is generally polished, but the fixed bottom navigation obscures content and several horizontal carousels are visibly clipped at the right edge.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar overlaps the second restaurant card, hiding its image continuation and likely its title/details.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page content, or ensure the page can scroll far enough that the final card is fully visible above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The category chip row and the 'Fastest near you' restaurant cards are cut off at the right edge; the third restaurant name is visibly truncated without an ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Keep the horizontal carousel if intentional, but provide a clearer scroll affordance and apply text truncation/ellipsis within card bounds so clipped content looks deliberate.
